title: Rory and the Moonlit Valley Blossoms
verses:
When the stars started winking above in the dark,
And Psittaco chirped from a nest in the trees,
He pointed his beak to a glittering park,
Where blossoms were swaying along with the breeze.

Big Rory stepped softly through mosses so deep,
While Nia swooped down with a shimmering glow.
Sweet Tilly was ready for cozying sleep,
As Benny walked slow in the valley below.

They gathered where blue-petaled lilies expand,
And Ricky sat down with his chin on his paw.
The sweet-scented night-blooms lit up in the land,
Inspiring a quiet and comforting awe.

Brave Benny sank into a carpet of green,
And rested his weary and grounded old bones.
A pillow of leaves made a bed for a queen,
While cricket songs hummed over moss-covered stones.

Tiny Psittaco tucked under Rory's warm side,
As Nia drifted down from the canopy high.
The shadowy forest was peaceful and wide,
Beneath the soft velvet of midnight's dark sky.

Friendly Rory let out a contented deep sigh,
And closed his bright eyes as the moon gave a beam.
A whispering breeze hummed a soft lullaby,
To carry the dinosaurs into a dream.
